people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
translations.bsb: “First let the children have their fill,” He said. “For it is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”
translations.kjv: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.
translations.asv: And he said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread and cast it to the dogs.
